# Sources consulted (Numista.Ai US coin reference build, Oct 2, 2026 ET)

Authority ranking used: US Mint (usmint.gov data/press) > statute (U.S. Code / Public Law) > PCGS CoinFacts / NGC > trade press (Coin World, CoinWeek, CoinNews) > dealer blogs / Wikipedia (secondary, flagged).

## US Mint (primary)
- Bullion Sales (American Eagle silver, monthly by calendar year, 1986-2026): https://www.usmint.gov/about/production-sales-figures/bullion-sales
  (data endpoint: /content/usmint/us/en/about/production-sales-figures/bullion-sales/jcr:content/root/container/productionsalesdata.dropdowns.json?firstDropdown=EAGLE&secondDropdown=MONTHLY&thirdDropdown=YYYY ; raw copy saved in _usmint_bullion_eagle_monthly_raw.json)
- Cumulative Sales (numismatic product net sales; report valid through 9/27/2026): https://www.usmint.gov/about/production-sales-figures/cumulative-sales (raw copy: _usmint_cumulative_sales_master.json)
- Circulating Coins Production, American Women Quarters program (firstDropdown=AWQS): https://www.usmint.gov/about/production-sales-figures/circulating-coins-production
- Product pages: 26EA, 26EG, 26RF, 25EM, 25EG, 25MPM, 23RF, 24RF, 25RF, 23RC, 24RC (usmint.gov/<slug>-<code>.html)
- Bullion privy program page: https://www.usmint.gov/coins-precious-metal-coins/bullion-coin-privy/
- Press releases: 2022, 2023 and 2024 AWQ design announcements; 2023 AWQ shipping-date releases; 2021 Reverse Proof set (21XJ); 2025 AWQ honorees (Oct 17, 2023); 2025 AWQ designs (Dec 18, 2024, via GlobeNewswire)

## Statute
- 31 U.S.C. §5112(e) (Silver Eagle specs) and §5112(x) (AWQ program; Pub. L. 116-330, Circulating Collectible Coin Redesign Act of 2020): https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/31/5112

## Grading services
- PCGS Security / NFC FAQ: https://www.pcgs.com/security
- PCGS NFC announcement: https://www.pcgs.com/news/groundbreaking-nfc-technology-included-in-all-holders
- PCGS Museum of Coin Holders: https://www.pcgs.com/holdermuseum
- PCGS CoinFacts category pages (Silver Eagles): https://www.pcgs.com/coinfacts/category/2950 and /2951
- NGC Security Center: https://www.ngccoin.com/security-center/
- NGC Holder & Label Security Features: https://www.ngccoin.com/security-center/features/
- NGC Counterfeit Detection: https://www.ngccoin.com/resources/counterfeit-detection/
- NGC Counterfeit 2023 Silver Eagle: https://www.ngccoin.com/news/article/11783/counterfeit-2023-silver-eagle/
- NGC articles 5888 (bullion facility attribution), 14132 and 14144 (2025 privies)
